title: Exact restriction compares a completed chart with ordinary composite pullback
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite coefficient extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $f:V\to W$ be any scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], and let $A\subseteq U\subseteq V$ be clopen opens, with inclusion $j:A\to U$. Use the completed integral coefficient sheaves and their module and derived categories [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $r_j$ be the existing normalized exact open module restriction and $D(r_j)$ its termwise derived functor [def-pur-open-completed-restriction-data]. For every complex $K$ on $W$ such that its ordinary uncompleted derived pullback $Lf^*K$ [def-sf-ordinary-integral-derived-pullback] is derived complete on $V$ [def-weil-derived-complete], there is an isomorphism $L(f\circ\iota_A)^*K\cong D(r_j)(L\iota_U^*_{\mathrm{comp}}(Lf^*K))$. The inner pullback is the completed integral pullback [def-pur-integral-derived-operations]. No affineness, boundedness or projective-model hypothesis is imposed; the restriction functor and its exactness are already constructed.

source.place: lemma-local-structure-constructible-complex (Tag 09C3), restriction of models to a refinement; Tags 03D8, 06YY and 08TC for ordinary restriction, composition, and completeness. This isolates step 2 and the compositor in step 3 of lem-fix-clopen-projective-chart-common-refinement.

proof.text: Write M=Lf*K. The ordinary nested-open restriction comparison identifies L(f∘ι_A)*K with D(r_j)D(r_U)M. This step contains no completed pullback or completeness hypothesis.
The canonical completion-unit criterion makes M→completion(M) invertible from the assumed completeness of M. Map this particular isomorphism through the two exact restrictions.

Evaluate the clopen completion/restriction factorization at M and apply D(r_j). Compose it with the preceding two isomorphisms to obtain the asserted comparison. This does not require A itself to be closed.

proof_origin.place: T8: steps 1–3 separated into an ordinary nested-open compositor, a clopen quotient-completion factorization, and the existing canonical completion-unit criterion. The delivered Lean composes these independently typed isomorphisms; it does not restate the assigned conclusion.

theorem clopen_completed_restriction_comparison
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (W V : Scheme.{u}) (f : V ⟶ W) (U A : V.Opens)
    (_hU : IsClosed (U : Set V)) (_hA : IsClosed (A : Set V)) (hAU : A ≤ U)
    (K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E W))
    (_hK : IntegralOnSlice.IsComplete l E V none ((ordinaryIntegralDerivedPull l E f).obj K)) :
    Nonempty ((ordinaryIntegralDerivedPull l E (A.ι ≫ f)).obj K ≅
      (OpenCompletedRestriction.derivedRestriction l E (V.homOfLE hAU)).obj
        ((integralDerivedPullback l E U.ι).obj
          ((ordinaryIntegralDerivedPull l E f).obj K)))
